name: pwdev-power
description: Disciplined, approval-gated development: product requirements, executable roadmap, brainstorm-gated plans, subagent-driven execution with a ledger and bounded fix loop, adversarial verification, and isolated cmux fleets.

interface.longDescription: Write a product requirement, decompose it into an executable roadmap, brainstorm and plan a feature behind an approval gate, execute it task by task with a durable ledger and a bounded fix loop, verify it adversarially, and run approved phases as isolated autonomous fleets.
defaultPrompt: Write a product requirement and decompose it into an executable roadmap.
Brainstorm and plan this feature before touching any code.
Execute this approved plan task by task with review between tasks.
Verify this implementation adversarially before claiming it is done.
Launch approved phases as an isolated autonomous fleet.
